newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares close mixed, eyes on results.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares close mixed, eyes on results.

text.p: Belgian shares closed little changed on Friday, encouraged back from session lows by the fact Wall Street digested slightly stronger than expected U.S. jobs date positively in the afternoon.
The Bel-20 index .BFX finished 1.18 point or 0.07 percent higher at 1,735.62, after falling to 1,723.28. Volume was a moderate 1.4 billion francs worth of Belgian shares.

Dealers said the focus was now on the thickening flow of company results. Retailer Delhaize, which ended 1.2 percent lower at 1,645 francs, announced a 22 percent rise in first half 1996 profit after market close, as expected.
Cement maker CBR also posted results after the close, announcing a rise in first half group net profit to 1.738 billion francs from 1.545 billion a year ago.
CBR shares closed five francs down at 2,310.
